home.story_title: A pioneer who shaped hair restoration in *Malaysia*

children.text: Datuk Dr Inderjit Kaur (DPSM), known to her patients as Dr Inder, is an LCP-certified aesthetic doctor licensed by the Ministry of Health Malaysia. She has spent more than 30 years diagnosing and treating hair loss, and is a Diplomate of the American Board of Hair Restoration Surgery and a Fellow of the International Society of Hair Restoration Surgery.

Surgeons, instrument inventors and professional bodies abroad know her work for its planning, its safety standards and results that look like the patient’s own hair. Patients travel to her Petaling Jaya practice from across Asia and beyond.

home.philosophy_quote: Hair restoration should never look artificial, and results should age naturally with the patient.

children.text: Datuk Dr Inder is a Diplomate of the
American Board of Hair Restoration Surgery (ABHRS)
, board certified by the
International Board of Hair Restoration Surgery (IBHRS)
, and a
Fellow of the International Society of Hair Restoration Surgery (FISHRS)
. She is a life member of the ISHRS and the
Asian Association of Hair Restoration Surgeons (AAHRS)
, and is board certified in aesthetic medicine by the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine (USA).
Datuk Dr Inder is known for her eye and technique in
hairline restoration, FUE hair transplantation and facial hair transplantation
, including
eyebrow design and beard restoration
. Every treatment is planned for the individual patient and carried out with U.S. FDA-cleared instruments, protocols and medication.
As President of the
FUE Society Malaysia

, Datuk Dr Inder works on professional standards and education in hair restoration, in Malaysia and across the region. She and her clinical team have trained with leading hair transplant surgeons, including
Dr John Cole
and
Dr Sanusi Umar
She is a former Exco member of the Malaysian Society of Aesthetic Medicine, and attends the ISHRS World Congress and other international meetings each year.
Datuk Dr Inder and Klinik Dr Inder have received awards including
Medical Aesthetic Clinic of the Year
Hair Transplant Clinic of the Year
Pioneer in Haircare Industry
and
Woman Innovator in Haircare Industry
at the Global Health Asia-Pacific Awards, the
Asia Hair Transplant, Aesthetics & Regenerative Clinic of the Year 2025
at the Top Asia Corporate Ball, and the
Successful Women Beauty Entrepreneur Award 2024
at the Asia Awards.

home.clinic_title: Klinik Dr Inder, where expertise meets *care*

children.text: An internationally recognised centre for hair restoration, aesthetic medicine and regenerative treatments. The clinic received WhatClinic’s Excellent Customer Service Award in 2017 and 2018, and MyDoc.Asia Certificates of Care Excellence from 2016 to 2018.
Dr Vaishnevi practises alongside Datuk Dr Inder, supporting the clinic’s work in hair transplantation and acne scar treatment.

publications.title: Scalp Micropigmentation Corrective Treatment with Hair Transplant
publications.journal: Journal of Asia Pacific Aesthetic Sciences (JAPA)
publications.abstract: Case report of a 31-year-old man with androgenetic alopecia (Norwood stage 4) left with an unnatural-looking hairline after scalp micropigmentation at a tattoo parlour. A new hairline was constructed with FUE: 2,000 grafts harvested from the donor area and implanted at 30 FU/cm² on the frontotemporal recesses and 40 FU/cm² on the frontal and part of the mid-scalp region.
